systems.platform: smartphone tool integrated into the DHIS2 platform
systems.owner: Ministry of Health and partners; project by INSP and Vital Strategies
systems.tiers: community health worker sites; birth and perinatal death notification in four health districts (Diéma, Kita, Sikasso, Kignan), the electronic form set up for all CHW sites

note: Conference abstract on community health workers notifying births and perinatal deaths by smartphone (729 live births and 35 perinatal deaths in 8 months); a community system only. DHIS2 is named as where the data was analysed and as the platform DISK-Mali is integrated into, with no description of aggregate facility reporting, so no hmis or emr fact.
